definitions.explanation: Each station along a railway line. Most commonly seen in the compound {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ} ('local train', literally 'stops at every station') and announcements about service stops.

examples.japanese: {各駅|かくえき}{停車|ていしゃ}は{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: The local train takes a long time.

examples.japanese: {急|いそ}いでいないので、{各駅|かくえき}{停車|ていしゃ}に{乗|の}って{景色|けしき}を{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: Since I wasn't in a hurry, I took the local train and enjoyed the scenery.

notes:
Compound of {各|かく} (each) + {駅|えき} (station). Outside the fixed compound {各駅|かくえき}{停車|ていしゃ}, it appears in service notices about which stations a train serves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {各駅|かくえき}{停車|ていしゃ}: local train (stops at every station)
- {各駅|かくえき}に{停|と}まる: to stop at every station
- {各駅|かくえき}に{掲示|けいじ}される: posted at every station

RELATED WORDS:
- {普通|ふつう}{列車|れっしゃ}: local train — synonym of {各駅|かくえき}{停車|ていしゃ}, used by JR
- {快速|かいそく}: rapid service — skips smaller stations
- {急行|きゅうこう}: express — stops at fewer stations than {快速|かいそく}
- {特急|とっきゅう}: limited express — stops at the fewest stations
